title: The effect of the EU's novel food regulations on firm investment decisions
authors: Varacca A; Soregaroli C; Kardung M; Espa I; Colombo I; Cortesi B
notes: Closest paper to research question: assesses EU novel food regs on firm investment via real option theory; 326 applications analysed; method and mechanism directly applicable

title: Global developments in the regulation of cultivated meat: A comparative study of the EU Singapore US and Australia and New Zealand
source: Review of European Comparative and International Environmental Law
notes: Comparative legal analysis of cultivated meat regulatory frameworks across four key jurisdictions; primary institutional reference

title: A perspective on the regulation of cultivated meat in the European Union
notes: Argues EU novel food framework is fit for cultivated meat; precautionary bans (Italy) not scientifically justified; regulatory legitimacy angle

title: The novel food evaluation process delays access to food innovation in the European Union
authors: Le Bloch J; Rouault M; Langhi C; Hignard M; Iriantsoa V; Michelet O
notes: Quantifies EFSA novel food approval timelines (292 applications 2018-2024); avg 2.56 yrs; potential empirical measure of regulatory stringency or delay

title: Cultured Meat: Promises and Challenges
notes: Economic overview of cultured meat; demand/supply dynamics and environmental uncertainty; launches economics research agenda for the sector

title: Bringing cultured meat to market: Technical socio-political and regulatory challenges in cellular agriculture
authors: Stephens N; Di Silvio L; Dunsford I; Ellis M; Glencross A; Sexton A
source: Trends in Food Science and Technology
notes: Foundational paper on regulatory and socio-political challenges for cellular agriculture commercialisation; widely cited baseline

title: Evaluation of public submissions to the USDA for labeling of cell-cultured meat in the United States
authors: Failla M; Hopfer H; Wee J
notes: Analyses 1151 USDA-FSIS public comments on cell-cultured meat labeling (2021); maps stakeholder positions on US regulatory process

title: Scale-up economics for cultured meat
notes: Techno-economic analysis of production cost barriers; bioprocess focus with minimal policy/econ content; defer unless connecting production costs to commercialisation outcomes

title: The Myth of Cultured Meat: A Review
notes: Critical food-science review; minimal economic or policy content; defer unless regulatory scepticism framing is needed for background

title: Cultured Meat and Cowless Milk: On Making Markets for Animal-Free Food
notes: Sociotechnical market-making framework for animal-free food; mechanism source for how regulation and legitimacy shape market formation

title: Cell-Cultivated Meat: An Overview
notes: US CRS report (R47697) on cultivated meat science; FDA/USDA regulatory framework; policy considerations for Congress (Sep 2023)

title: 2023 State of the Industry Report: Cultivated Meat and Seafood
notes: Annual investment and firm data: $225.9M raised in 2023 ($3.1B cumulative since 2013); includes regulatory milestone tracker

title: 2022 State of the Industry Report: Cultivated Meat and Seafood
notes: Annual investment and firm data: ~$900M raised in 2022; 679 unique investors; regulatory milestone tracker; key investment data source

title: Cultivating control? How cultured meat threatens Food Sovereignty
notes: Food sovereignty critique of cultivated meat industry model; defer unless studying distributional or legitimacy mechanisms in regulatory context

title: A Theoretical Framework for A Sustainable Innovation Process of Cellular Agriculture Technology: A Country- and Firm-Specific Advantages Perspective
authors: Jalali Sepehr M; Alvarado-Vargas M; Mashhadi Nejad N
notes: CSA/FSA theoretical framework for cellular agriculture adoption across jurisdictions; working paper only; defer unless cross-country innovation variation is modelled

title: Stock market response to food safety regulations
authors: Mazzocchi M; Ragona M; Fritz M
notes: Event study methodology applied to food safety regulatory changes; stock market response to EU contaminant regulation 1881/2006; 30 LSE food firms; method analogy for cultivated meat regulatory event study

title: An event study of the effects of regulatory changes on the food industry: The case of the Food Safety Law of China
notes: Event study of China Food Safety Law on food industry CARs; firm characteristics cross-section; dairy sub-industry underperforms; direct method and setting analogy for regulatory event study

title: Food safety, reputation, and regulation
notes: Empirical economics review of food safety reputation and regulation; demand effects of safety events; information disclosure policy design; background for regulatory legitimacy and market response mechanisms

title: 2024 State of the Industry: Cultivated meat seafood and ingredients
notes: Annual investment data: $139M in 2024 (lowest since 2019); 40% decline from 2023; regulatory milestones and firm-level data; extends GFI annual series to 2024

title: Measuring Economic Policy Uncertainty
authors: Baker SR; Bloom N; Davis SJ
notes: EPU index constructed from newspaper coverage; policy uncertainty depresses investment; foundational reference for linking regulatory uncertainty to firm decision-making; QJE 131(4):1593-1636

title: A Deeper Dive into Alternative Protein Investments in 2022: The Case for Optimism
notes: GFI authors; $14.2B raised in alt-protein over decade; sector-level investment trends 2022; peer-reviewed investment data complementing GFI annual reports

title: Pre-Market Approval and Its Impact on Food Innovation: The Novel Foods Example
source: Regulating and Managing Food Safety in the EU (Springer)
notes: Legal-economic analysis of EU novel food pre-market approval; investment deterrence from process uncertainty; lack of binding timelines and data protection as key barriers; mechanism background

title: The State of Global Policy on Alternative Proteins 2023
notes: Cross-jurisdiction regulatory policy landscape; $523M public investment in alt-proteins in 2023; country-level policy comparison US EU Singapore Israel; key source for regulatory timeline construction
